name: new_v2_six_observed_axis_with_synthetic_quality_envelope_v1
quality_axis: Equal mean of six prespecified synthetic-fault family coordinates: eight-channel-dropout mean, half-gain, q95 clipping, 50 Hz half-RMS line noise, half-RMS baseline ramp and channel-0 burst; clean excluded
aggregation: unweighted descriptive mean and minimum of six axis-specific macro-F1 values; retain worst named fault and worst subject/fault cell independently
selection: Report all four arms and both phases; retain F0v2 posture-validation selection, no final-based switch
boundary: Synthetic faults applied to public 8-channel ROAM static resting windows; no observed hardware-fault prevalence or own 250 Hz device claim. Quality and posture share ROAM users, day and user share GRABMyo records; force and other axes use different labels/rates. Six-axis mean is descriptive, not pooled accuracy; explicit execution-speed and real hardware-quality measurements remain unavailable.
